pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark brown regions with relatively smooth edge gradients on the upper flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented and angular geometries on the lower posterior and leg regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored inter-patch spaces featuring well-defined tri-axial and quadri-axial junction nodes; pathway thickness is generally consistent across the mid-section with slight widening at the base of the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette is visible along the superior boundary of the neck, indicating a short, dense mane structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, dark avian organisms (oxpeckers) are perched along the dorsal ridge, shoulder, and lateral neck regions.
